underlying_release: double-conversion 3.2.0 (vendored in the ujson sdist; string-to-double for JSON numbers with a fraction or exponent)
build_note: Source-built from the pinned sdist with clang/clang++ -O0, LLVM source coverage and UJSON_BUILD_NO_STRIP=1. The official aarch64 cp311 wheel compiles the same sources into one stripped, optimised extension; optimisation and symbol stripping differ.
api: ujson.loads(local JSON bytes); ujson.loads(decoded str) is checked against the same oracle
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: LLVM source-region coverage of the source-built ujson extension: ujson decode.c, module glue, dconv_wrapper.cc and vendored double-conversion C++
scope: JSON structure and values from local bytes via ujson.loads; valid nested object and nested array controls only, each matching an exact type-tagged CPython json oracle tree
